_comment: Copy to ~/.inbox-watch/config.json. Secrets never live here — they come from env vars (see `inbox-watch setup`).

mailbox._comment: A token-gated service exposing GET /api/inbound, e.g. machin-resend-inbox. Token via INBOX_TOKEN. Preferred over `resend`: a read-only token cannot send mail as you.

imap._comment: Password via ZOHO_IMAP_PASS. Needs an app-specific password and IMAP enabled for this mailbox.

github._comment: Needs the authenticated `gh` CLI. `self` is your login, used to ignore your own comments.

threads._comment: Issues/PRs where you left something and want the answer — GitHub buries these under subscribed-repo noise.
threads.label: the RFC thread
